research_question: Does low-learning-rate planning fine-tuning of a NAVSIM-adapted LPWM produce particles useful for trajectory planning while preserving visual dynamics?
precision: FP32 official image encoder, BF16 dynamics/planner, activation checkpointing
schedule: linear warmup 1 percent updates, cosine decay to 10 percent initial LR
planner_input: four observed RGB frames, current 8D ego status, causal eight-step LPWM prior rollout
encoder_conditioning: zero-initialized bounded FiLM from current four-dimensional driving command inside particle attribute CNN
planning_loss: smooth L1 waypoint XY + 0.5 mean(1-cos heading error)
world_loss: unchanged official stage1 temporal ELBO on independently sampled training clips, never future input to planner
data: all eligible observed-input navtrain training records, same recording validation split as stage1; no fixed clip cap
checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch, epoch diagnostics do not select the best development checkpoint
evaluation: full development ADE/FDE, future-branch and command interventions, official PDM on available cached development tokens; independent full navtest afterwards
